research_claim: A low-capacity auditable pre-generation policy can learn four resource on/off decisions over 16 legal actions and improve the quality-risk-cost tradeoff under a fixed resource and generation stack.
withdraws: any formal MP/MS/ME conclusion derived from historical needed_memory_sources proxy data

evidence_roles.RS_routing_gold: qualified same-state fixed-protocol paired material benefit, followed by applicable atomic risk and cost gates
evidence_roles.RS_pre_action_resource_need_bits: scope, coverage, negative-control, and transparent-feature design only; not sufficient for RS-on gold
evidence_roles.MP_MS_ME_routing_gold: not yet frozen; must follow a component-specific treatment construct and cannot be inferred from historical proxies or the RS result
evidence_roles.matched_response_pairs: RS benefit-head training proxy plus resource-capacity and frozen end-to-end evaluation evidence
evidence_roles.claim_boundary: a human-adjudicated deterministic paired outcome is a protocol-specific training proxy, not an individual causal treatment effect or human clinical benefit

strategy_rag.source: ESConv train split plus existing train-derived candidate catalog

human_review_budget.H1: complete final RAG and retrieval review
human_review_budget.historical_H2: retrieval opportunity and candidate-suitability diagnosis only; not an RS benefit label
human_review_budget.RS_effect_quality: one bounded quality-only decision for each of 32 fresh same-stack pairs
human_review_budget.RS_effect_risk: atomic review only for human-adjudicated RS material wins
human_review_budget.H3: one final blind end-to-end response review after policy freeze
human_review_budget.additional_micro_packets: forbidden unless a documented schema or integrity defect makes a frozen packet unusable

model.primary: four independent L2 logistic regression heads
model.loss: group-weighted binary cross entropy plus L2

external_roles.ESConv: single-session RS and correct memory-off evaluation
